howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Chat SDK 接入 Matrix，接收和回复房间或私聊消息。安装时会自动复制适配器、注册模块、安装依赖、修补 ESM 导入并运行构建测试。需要一个独立的机器人账号。
howto.when: 当用户要求为当前实例添加 Matrix 渠道或接入 Matrix 聊天时触发。

say.note: 开始复制适配器并配置机器人账号。

say.text: 把机器人接入 Matrix 房间
say.note: 完成注册与构建后即可接收房间消息。

say.text: 配置 Matrix 机器人凭据
say.note: 引导输入服务器地址和账号信息。

howto.what_en: Claude can connect to Matrix via Chat SDK, handling room and DM messages. Setup copies the adapter, registers it, installs deps, patches ESM imports, and builds. A separate bot account is needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Matrix support or connect the bot to Matrix rooms or DMs.

say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and configuring the bot account.

say_en.text: Connect the bot to Matrix rooms.
say_en.note: After registration and build, room messages are received.
Prompts for server URL and account details.
